title: IonQ Appoints Gary Merrill as CFO and Thomas Austin as Chief Accounting Officer
html:
Insider Brief

  • IonQ has announced two finance leadership appointments, naming Gary Merrill as chief financial officer and Thomas A. Austin to the newly created role of chief accounting officer.
  • Merrill, currently CFO of Commvault Systems, will join IonQ in early December, while Austin, formerly chief accounting officer at Juniper Networks, takes up his position immediately.
  • The appointments coincide with Inder M. Singh stepping down from his roles at IonQ, as the company focuses on scaling its operations and pursuing long-term profitability.

PRESS RELEASE — IonQ (NYSE: IONQ), the world’s leading full-stack quantum platform and foundry, today announced executive leadership changes to position the company for continued growth and advance its path to profitability:

  • Gary Merrill, currently Chief Financial Officer of Commvault Systems, Inc., has been appointed Chief Financial Officer, effective early December.
  • Thomas A. Austin, former Chief Accounting Officer at Juniper Networks, an HPE company, has been appointed to the newly created position of Chief Accounting Officer, effective immediately.

In connection with these appointments, Inder M. Singh is stepping down from his roles at the company, effective immediately.

“Inder has been in an important role at IonQ both before and since stepping off the board to join the management team,” said Niccolo de Masi, Chairman and CEO of IonQ. “In just the last two years, we have evolved from a quantum computing company pioneer into the world’s leading full-stack quantum platform and foundry company. I thank Inder and wish him well in future endeavors.”

Mr. de Masi continued, “Gary and Tom bring extensive public company experience across finance and accounting that will be increasingly important as IonQ continues to scale and hone its long-term path to profitability. Gary’s experience as a public company CFO with deep cybersecurity expertise will be particularly valuable as our quantum computing leadership accelerates and we focus on building the quantum ecosystem.”

Mr. Merrill said, “IonQ is leading the quantum computing industry, and I am excited to join at such a pivotal moment in the company’s history. Throughout my career as an operator, commercial leader and CFO, I have seen firsthand the importance of pairing ambitious growth plans with disciplined financial management. IonQ’s robust balance sheet is a distinct advantage in the quantum industry, giving the company the strength to accelerate its technical and commercial leadership. I look forward to partnering with Niccolo, the leadership team and the finance organization to drive strong execution and long-term value creation for IonQ and its shareholders.”

Mohib Ur Rehman

Get the latest research, company news, and market intelligence every week.

MENTIONED IN THE ARTICLE

IonQ is a developer in trapped ion quantum computing founded in 2015 that actively applies its technology to the aerospace and defense sectors. The company empowers satellite-based quantum networks and quantum enabled drones to improve positioning, navigation, and timing resilience in GPS denied environments, and collaborates with industry leaders like Airbus to optimize aircraft loading.
